notes.title: Version 2.0 is here
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695256/09d0e1eb8fcf507622f3553e58317fd043895b78.png

We are so happy to announce that Taekwondo Grand Prix 2.0 is finally here for you to enjoy. There will be a week-long discount of 75% to celebrate the release. After that, there will be a slight price increase to keep the Steam price on par with the Stove version. We will run some Steam key giveaways via our Twitter account (https://twitter.com/hellotheregames) so keep an eye on that and help spread the word. 

With this, we would like to welcome everybody back to the arena. For all you faithful players, you will get to play the game right now, new players will have to wait a couple of hours before the Purchase button is back on the store, please note that the tournaments will commence on the 18th, but you are free to sign up starting today. Also keep in mind to select a region closest to where you live for the best experience.

How can I report issues that I come across?
You can either report them here at the Steam Community or via our discord, https://discord.gg/cpCQaZJ

The game has a built-in replay feature that saves all matches in a format so that we can step through them frame by frame for debugging purposes. If you, during a match, find something that looks odd, maybe a kick that didn’t register a hit or a score that wasn’t awarded properly please send us the replay file to dev@hellothere.se , it will help us tremendously with finding the bug as we can recreate the match on our end.

The replay files can be found here:
C:|Users|[username]|AppData|LocalLow|Hello There Games|Taekwondo Grand Prix|Replays

We hope to see you in the arena!

notes.title: PATCH 1.9.5 OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33695256/d3caab44c93450bf41f9b0705dc849a9a9dafdb0.png

GAME INTRODUCTION
The introduction to the game was, to be fair, something awkward and weird and kind of inherited from the mobile days of the game. We did something about that. About time, huh. 

SCORE BALANCING & RESULT SCREEN MMR 
First. The reward for winning a match and the penalty for losing one wasn’t quite balanced in the way we wanted it to be. So we rebalanced it, slightly. 
Second. Winning or losing - your reward or penalty in the score is now more visible and readable. Check it out in your result screen next time you finish a match.

MATCHMAKING 1: PRACTICE MODE
If you loved having nothing to do in the game while matchmaking - this is a sad update for you. Don’t worry, we’ll rip that bandaid off together, okay? Ready? Steady? Kapaow! Queueing up for a match now offers active practice mode. 

MATCHMAKING 2: NEW ARENA
One could argue that the use of “NEW” is a bit exaggerated here. We simply dimmed the lights in the Dojang arena. But hey, this is in the world of games and far bigger games have gotten away with far lesser cosmetic changes and called it an E X P A N S I O N. So, here we are. A new arena. Awesome!

ANIMATIONS 1: K.O. CELEBRATION
As if winning by K.O. didn’t feel awesome enough for you - and embarrassing enough for the losing part - we just added celebrating animations to the winner. Then again, if you’re a good sport about losing, you’ll enjoy the new content as well. Because that’s who we are. A bunch of good losers. Yeah.

ANIMATIONS 2: IMPACT
Hitting someone with a kick should feel awesome. Rewarding. Juicy. Intense. Moist. Flashy. Cool. We added some more impact animations on successful kicks. 

FONT SUPPORT
Letters are important. So are special characters and symbols and most of all - your names. We love your names. Our font did not reflect this love. Now it does. 

BONUS: CLOTH
Apparently, our Art Director spent some time exploring some kind of cloth animation for the leaderboard. That’s on the menu screen. Apparently, that was “totally necessary”. And apparently, it only took a “reasonable amount of time” to implement it. So, apparently, it’s in the game now. Leaderboard cloth. It’s a thing. 

PS. Our Art Director’s name in the game is Filip. Extra kudos for beating him.

notes.title: NEW PATCH: 1.8.1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33695256/5c6531a2a9b046cc0ae596b1206e9ae9585f77b6.jpg


GLOBAL STEAM LEADERBOARDS
Ever heard of the phrase “dance like no one’s watching”? Definitely not compatible with fighting. What’s the point of being awesome and winning with no bragging rights? 
Visit the Global Steam Leaderboards in-game or by this link on Steam:
https://steamcommunity.com/stats/462590/leaderboards/3109617

NEW EFFECTS
What’s better than kicking your friend in the face? Kicking your friend in the face while the whole screen rumbles and flashes to praise your unmatched skill!

NEW FACES
You’re bad at remembering faces? Are you that person who exits a room with a bunch of people and introduces yourself to someone you just talked to inside, 30 seconds ago? You’re gonna hate this one. For all others who believe that more is merrier and that diversity is a kind of a nice thing - this is for you.

TYLER IS IN
Speaking of faces, Tyler is in! Who’s Tyler, you ask? Oh, just the guy who won the eSport premiere of Taekwondo at the Grand Prix-event in Manchester! If you listen carefully, you can still hear the echo of the crowd, cheering for Tyler throughout eternity.

IN-GAME RESOLUTION FIXES
That pop-up you got when booting up the game? It’s gone. Resolution is now adjusted inside the game.

notes.title: NEW PATCH: 1.8.0
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33695256/772d4f52491a0650b9910ec960749ab9c93e243e.jpg

TRADING CARDS ARE IN
Did you miss them? Of course you did! So did we! And like strike of magic - here they are! Enjoy!

ENDLESS MODE ACTUALLY GETS HARDER NOW
Sorry if you thought you were THAT awesome or that the game was just STUPID simple. Now, the “Endless AI” mode should work as intended. Up for the challenge?

THAT STUCK-IN-LOADING-BUG
It was more embarrassing for us than it was insulting to you, we hope. But hey, we fixed that and let’s not mention it when we meet with the family at xmas and everyone start telling awkward stories about each other? Pretty please?

FORFEITING A GAME
The scoring has been working properly all the way, we just cleared things up for you when it happens in the future. (Tip: Don’t forfeit games. It’s annoying for your opponent and it’s bad for your scoring!)

RENAMED MENU OPTIONS
Let’s face it, our options in the menu were suboptimal at best, a bit confusing at worst. So we cleared them up for you.  
 
NO MORE SILENCE I: AMBIENCE
It was cool at first, right? The whole mysterious no-music-during-the-fights-thing? Nah, neither thought we. Now there’s a sweet ambience-y tune playing, to really massage your ears while kicking your friends in the face. Yum.

NO MORE SILENCE II: TAB OUT
If you like to tab out while waiting in queue to fight - no worries. We’ve got your back. The game now let’s you know when a match is about to start. You just go ahead with watching memes, hoarding stuff from auction sites or scrolling your social medias like something will have changed since last time. 

PERSISTENT CROWD & LIGHTING
Did the crowd disappear after your first Manchester match? Don’t worry, it wasn’t you, it was totally us. Now they’ll stay. Forever. And ever… Oh, and to make them really feel present, we made sure the light stays on them.

OTHER
- Removed everything connected to the Manchester event
- Added pretty game box art for Twitch
